messages.subject: Adding packrat to existing shiny folder
parts:

  No DESCRIPTION file at path 'C:/Users/sravindran/Documents/packtest/packrat/lib/x86_64-w64-mingw32/3.2.0/R6/DESCRIPTION'!  I can confirm that I don't have the description file, where can I find it?

Thank you
